div.strong: Keep it secret, keep it safe.
div.p: Your webhook URL contains a secret. Don't share it online or carelessly.

button.name: action_shopify_rotate_webhook_uuid
button.help: Change the URL's secret if you think the URL is no longer secure. You will have to update any automated system that calls this webhook to the new URL.

ul.li: Shopify has implemented a five-second timeout period and a retry period for webhook subscriptions.

Shopify waits five seconds for a response to each request to a webhook. If there's no response, or an error is returned, then Shopify retries the connection 19 times over the next 48 hours. If there are 19 consecutive failures, then the webhook subscription is automatically deleted. A warning that the subscription will be deleted is sent to the app's emergency developer email address.
If you continue to receive failure notifications, you will need to deactivate the related webhook and then activate it again.
If an instance is reset to the Draft state, the associated webhooks will be automatically set to Inactive
If an instance is confirmed again, the related webhooks will not be activated automatically and need to be activated manually.
Only instances with an SSL connection (https://) are permitted.
The webhooks created using the API do not appear in the Shopify admin panel.
